text: Re-read 2026-08-17. Both comments verified. 'write_cache=False makes this a pure read - no pickle warmed. Required by read-only tools - see the fences in dig.py, viz.py and console' still holds: those three modules carry 7 write_cache=False call sites between them, and the read fence tests the resulting guarantee end to end. 'Read the generation BEFORE anything overwrites it' also stands - stale_sketches is read here and record_sketch_version runs later in cmd_index, so the read genuinely precedes the stamp.
